_help: Private question pool for the Lumen Protocol course (15 to 30 questions). answer must match one option exactly. This folder is never shown to visitors; the server marks the answers.

questions.question: What is Lumen?
questions.explain: Lumen lets you lend tokens or borrow against them.

questions.question: What do you earn by supplying tokens to a Lumen pool?
questions.explain: Borrowers pay interest, which is shared with suppliers.

questions.question: To borrow $100 on Lumen, what do you need to lock first?
questions.explain: Loans are backed by more collateral than the loan.

questions.question: In the lesson example, how much collateral backs a $100 loan?
questions.explain: Locking $150 to borrow $100 leaves room for prices to move.

questions.question: What does the health factor show?
questions.explain: It measures how close a loan is to being liquidated.

questions.question: Which health factor is safe?
questions.explain: Above 1 is safe; below 1 the loan can be liquidated.

questions.question: What can happen when the health factor drops below 1?
questions.explain: Below 1, part of the collateral can be sold.

questions.question: What happens in a liquidation?
options: Part of the collateral is sold to repay the loan, plus a penalty
questions.answer: Part of the collateral is sold to repay the loan, plus a penalty
questions.explain: Liquidations repay the loan from your collateral.

questions.question: How can you avoid a liquidation?
questions.explain: Both raise your health factor.

questions.question: Why might your collateral lose value?
questions.explain: Collateral is worth whatever its token trades at.

questions.question: Where should you use Lumen?
options: Only on the official Lumen site
Any link sent in a DM
questions.answer: Only on the official Lumen site
questions.explain: Fake sites copy real apps to steal funds.

questions.question: Who should you share your seed phrase with?
questions.explain: No real app or support team ever needs it.

questions.question: Are Lumen's interest rates fixed?
options: No, they change all the time
questions.answer: No, they change all the time
questions.explain: Rates move with supply and demand.

questions.question: What should you keep an eye on while borrowing?
questions.explain: It tells you when your loan is getting risky.

questions.question: Who pays the interest that suppliers earn?
questions.explain: Interest flows from borrowers to suppliers.

questions.question: Why is collateral worth more than the loan?
options: So the loan stays covered if prices move
Because it is a rule of all apps
questions.answer: So the loan stays covered if prices move
questions.explain: The extra gives room before a liquidation.

questions.question: If prices fall and you do nothing, what can happen to your loan?
questions.explain: Falling collateral lowers the health factor.

questions.question: What is a lending pool?
options: Tokens supplied by many people that borrowers can borrow
questions.answer: Tokens supplied by many people that borrowers can borrow
questions.explain: Pools gather supply from many users.

questions.question: Does a liquidation cost you extra?
questions.explain: The penalty is on top of repaying the loan.

questions.question: What is Lumen in this course?
options: A made up project for testing
questions.answer: A made up project for testing
questions.explain: It is a sample course. Nothing here is advice.
